name: @sentori/webapp
description: Sentori v0.1 minimal dashboard shell. Imports from self-hosted/web + saas/web.

scripts.check: tsc -b --noEmit && eslint . && node devtools/check-i18n.mjs && node devtools/check-hardcoded-text.mjs && node devtools/check-error-format.mjs && node devtools/check-cjk-punctuation.mjs && node devtools/check-unreferenced.mjs && bun devtools/check-highlight.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types devtools/check-credential-recognition.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types devtools/check-release-lights.mjs
